column2: They say an old man breathes with the waves at a seaside shrine south of the West Sea Cliffs
The sea doesn't block. It covers.
Old Man of the Azure Sea
They say a veteran who handles fire lives at an undying fire altar beyond the red wasteland to the east
Fire doesn't ask. It just burns everything.
They say someone who kicks the wind lives on a far southwest hill where the wind never stops
You can't catch the wind. So you can't block it either.
They say an old man sits like water in a pavilion in the middle of the southwest lake
Water doesn't fight. That's why it wins.
They say the bell never stops ringing at the temple on the stone terrace to the northeast
An unbreakable body is an unbreakable mind.
They say a woman dances with the petals deep in the plum forest to the northwest
A flower blooms all at once. Hesitate and it falls.
They say an old man lives beneath a golden dragon pillar on a rocky peak at the far east
A dragon lies low and waits, then splits the sky.
They say a shadow with no footsteps lives in the black valley at the far west
A foot you can see is already a late foot.
They say lightning strikes the iron-pillar plateau to the southeast every single day
While you think, you're already late. The body has to move first.
They say an old man at the southern inn is always drunk, yet no one has ever seen him fall
A drunk doesn't fall. He only pretends to.
The road was always open. Few ever walked it.
They say a nameless old man sits at the southwest end of the world, where the clouds touch the ground
At first there was nothing. So anything could be.
They say one who knows the beginning of the world stands beneath a towering peak above the northern cloud sea
The sun sets and the moon rises. I have always stood between them.
They say one who reached the summit with a single fist stands on an altar at the southeast end of the world, where sun and moon rise together
Time that has flowed never returns. So I spend each move carefully.
They say an old man who stopped time stands atop a thousand stairs reaching the clouds at the far northwest
Ice cliffs of the northern snow mountains
Ruined shrine in the Poison Mist Swamp
Blood Wolf of Blood Moon Valley
Ice Demon of the Snow Mountain

Young one, you want to enter the martial world bare-handed? Good. Start with the basics. The Three Powers Fist is already in your body. The thugs in the fields south of the village have been causing trouble lately, so deal with them first.
Let's loosen up. Hit the training dummy at the village entrance eight times. Keep clicking (👊 on mobile) to chain combos.
Put your weight into one blow. Land two heavy strikes (right-click, 💥 on mobile) on the dummy. Heavy strikes are slow but wear down balance a lot.
Every style has skills. Press E to use a Three Powers skill on the dummy. Skills use Ki and need a moment to recharge.
Defeat five field thugs. Don't flail. Deflect with F when they strike, then move in.
A fist comes from the body. Train eight times at the village training spots. Hit the beat for double.
Fill your stats through fighting and training to reach Second-Rate. From Second-Rate, enhanced training opens up: faster beats, but triple gains.
Bandit gangs have camped in the western bamboo forest and the eastern valley. Defeat six bandit swordsmen.

The Three Powers Fist alone won't get you far. Ten masters hide across the martial world. Follow the rumors on the notice board and seek one out. The story of the drunk old man at the southern inn is the closest.
A master doesn't take just anyone. Press T beside a master to request a test, and pass their test (deflecting, enduring, or sparring with disciples).
Once you've passed, offer silver and learn the style. You can switch styles anytime in the Styles window (menu).
A new style only sticks if you use it. Hit enemies with it to raise its mastery to 3. At mastery 3 its second skill (R) opens.
Build stats through training and fighting to reach First-Rate. Your body changes greatly with each realm. Iron Palm Training opens at First-Rate.
Use only one style and foes will read you. Follow the rumors to another master, pass the test, and learn one more style.
Pass First-Rate to Elite and your body changes once more. Ki Circulation opens at Elite. Fill your stats through training and hunting to reach Elite.
Black Tiger, chief of the bandit den in the far north, has his eye on the village. Defeat him.
Raise a style's mastery to 5. At mastery 5 its Secret Art (G) opens. It's the move you use when your Ki is full.

Enemies and bosses sometimes drop manual scrolls. Open a scroll in the 📜 Manuals tab of the General Store to get a manual, and fit it into one of three slots. A single manual supports your whole style.
A pirate gang has landed at the West Sea Cliffs in the far west. At Elite you can take them. Defeat eight pirate swordsmen.
You can equip up to three manuals. Open scrolls to collect three. Even a weak manual beats an empty slot.
One master's style isn't enough. Follow the rumors on the notice board and find up to three masters. Masters you find appear on the map.
Climb the Thousand-Floor Tower in the village. Each floor has a set strength, and a boss guards every ten floors. Scrolls and big rewards wait on each boss floor the first time. Clear ten floors.
Blood Wolf, a lackey of the Blood Cult, lurks under the blood-red moon in the far southeast. Defeat him.
You need to be at Peak to face the Blood Cult. Raise your body with realm training and your masters' styles.
If there's a master you've found but haven't learned from yet, pass their test and learn another style. Different styles work on different enemies.
Use a style long enough and its mastery rises. At mastery 6 the style awakens, opening its awakening skill (F), and its skills get stronger. Raise your current style to mastery 6.
Pass Peak to reach Supreme Peak. Golden Bell Training at the Advanced Training Grounds opens at Supreme Peak.
Ice Demon, lord of the northern snow mountains, has joined the Blood Cult. Break through the ice and defeat him.
Reach Transformation, where ki is handled like fire. Thousand-Pound Training opens and you can gain a second insight from Transformation.
A style at mastery 10 can rise a grade through insight. In the Styles window, pick a mastery-10 style and gain insight (costs silver).
Blood Cult Headquarters at the far northeast. Defeat ten cultists to open the way.
Reach Mystic. Grand Circulation opens at Mystic. You need this kind of body to face the Blood Demon's hand.
The Blood Demon, master of the Blood Cult. Give it everything. Defeat him and his hand is yours.
Two insights in one style raise its damage a lot and open the gate to awakening. Pick a mastery-10 style and gain its second insight.
Reach Brink, the threshold of death. Inner Demon Duel and Sky Walk open at Brink. Beat your inner demon for a big stat boost.
If your hand beat the Blood Demon, Life & Death isn't far. Field enemies are most rewarding in lands at your level. Check the recommended power on the map, pick a land, and reach Life & Death.
After Life & Death comes Mythic. Only a handful ever get this far. Reach Mythic.

A master at Life & Death sees the hidden end of their styles. Max out an original style's mastery and gain two insights, then return to its master and pass the Awakening Trial. Learn one awakened (True) style.
Reach Heaven-Human Unity, where heaven and man become one. Then the village's Heaven Gate opens.
Ascend through the Heaven Gate in the village. The Sky Palace above the clouds is safe and has a heavenly inn and a sky gem shop. Your map switches to the heavenly map automatically when you go up.
Heavenly enemies give more than earthly ones and drop sky gems and heavenly materials. Defeat eight cloud soldiers on the Cloud Plain south of the Sky Palace.
The Blood Demon has fallen too. But a strange energy is leaking from the Void Rift in the far northwest. Reach Limitless. Don't forget to upgrade your styles through insight.
A rumor only those at Limitless can hear: a nameless old man sits at the southwest end of the world, where the clouds touch the ground. Get the sky-opening fist from him.
Enter the Cloud Maze gate in the Sky Palace plaza, clear the rooms and defeat the maze's master. Enemies scale to the strength of whoever enters.
Climb to floor thirty of the village's Thousand-Floor Tower. Scrolls await on every boss floor.
Defeat six Heavenly Demon apostles in the Void Rift to open the way.
Different styles work on different enemies. Find one more master and learn a fifth style.
The Heavenly Demon, leader of the Demon Cult. He was moving the martial world from behind the Blood Cult. Defeat him to end the war on earth.
With the Heavenly Demon fallen, the Fire Mountain in the far east has awakened. Defeat the Flame Emperor beneath it.
The Snake King has burst from his grave in the sand tomb at the far south. Go to the tomb and put him back to rest.
The Heaven Gate General blocks the road to the Beyond Peak above the northern cloud sea.
The Thunder Emperor wields lightning on Thunder Peak beyond the bridge east of the Sky Palace. Heavenly bosses drop heavenly materials. Defeat the Thunder Emperor.
The Heavenly Lord guards the throne of heaven at the Throne Terrace north of the Sky Palace. Defeat the master of the heavens.
Reach Half-Immortal, between man and immortal.
Reach Ascension, climbing on the clouds. Beyond Heaven isn't far.
Reach the end of the realms, Beyond Heaven. There is a sky beyond the sky.
Beyond the arena gate in the Sky Palace plaza waits Cheongeop, the calamity of the heavens. Go in together and bring it down.
Climb to floor fifty of the Thousand-Floor Tower. Rewards climb steeply the higher you go.
Find the Origin Sage beneath the Beyond Peak, pass the test, and gain the Genesis Fist. The single fist from the moment the world first opened.

If you hold even the Genesis Fist, listen. At the Sun-Moon Altar at the southeast end of the world is the Fist Sovereign, sun and moon in hand. Surpass him and gain the Sun-Moon Fist. That is the summit of all styles.
Beyond Heaven is not the end. If you're reborn, your realm starts over but your body grows stronger (double stat gains), and realms beyond Beyond Heaven open one by one. Rebirth from the menu.

Each rebirth earns two merits. In the stats window, under '♻ Rebirth Perks', spend merits on a perk (HP, damage, Absorption, Inner Heart, Fortune, Insight, Gale). Perks stay through rebirths, and you can refund and pick again anytime.

Climbing again from Third-Rate, when you reach Life & Death your past self appears as a shadow. Summon and defeat it with '☯ Rebirth Trial' in the stats window. Each one you pass gives a merit, sky gems and scrolls, and the shadow leaves behind a rebirth style (Rebirth Fist · Karmic Fire Fist · Impermanence Fist · Fist King Fist).

Raise an original style and its awakened style to mastery 20 and gather materials found only in the heavens, and a hidden master of transcendence will grant a trial. Learn one Transcendent (Ultimate) style. The Ultimate Art (X) is a move that turns the sky upside down.
Climb to floor one hundred of the Thousand-Floor Tower. Silver and stats climb steeply the higher you go.
Climb again in your reborn body and pass Beyond Heaven. Primordial is open.
Climb past Beyond Heaven to Primordial again and be reborn a second time. Each rebirth increases stat gains, so the climb gets much faster than the first time.
The second shadow waits at Life & Death in your second life. It's tougher than the first. Trust the perks you chose with your merits.
Reach Boundless, the realm without end.
Reach Boundless and be reborn a third time. Time to choose perks again: for fighting, or for climbing faster?
The third shadow knows your habits. Use only your usual skills and you'll be blocked.
Reach Great Void, the realm of the empty sky. Your fourth rebirth awaits.
Reach Great Void and be reborn a fourth time. The Fist King's seat is near. But two rebirths still remain.
The wheel of rebirth sends out the last shadow. Only you, having passed all four lives, can take the Fist King's seat.
You've passed four lives. Become the Fist King. In the bare-handed martial world there is only one king. But the road continues even beyond the throne.
Now there's no one in the martial world who doesn't know your name. Styles left to learn, hidden masters, full awakening and upgrades. And you are now the Fist King. The road never ends.
You don't need to knock me down. Deflect. Press F when it flashes over your head, right before my fist lands. Deflect %d times and I'll take you as a disciple.
